# shc_vms (Data Source)

Lists all VMs on the SHC account. Useful for inventory tracking and cost analysis.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The data source ID (always 'vms').
- `vms` (Attributes List) The list of VMs on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) The VM hostname.
- `ip` (String) The primary IP address.
- `package` (String) The package name (e.g. NVMe VPS - Starter).
- `provisioning_state` (String) The provisioning state.
- `service_id` (String) The SHC service ID.
- `status` (String) The service status (active, pending, canceled).

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "shc_vms" "all" {}

output "vm_count" {
  value = length(data.shc_vms.all.vms)
}

output "vm_hostnames" {
  value = [for vm in data.shc_vms.all.vms : vm.hostname]
}
```
